title: Travel and the perspective of a blind traveler
text:
I loved this piece in the NYT Daily podcast (with Michael Barbaro). The piece explores traveling with a blind person and the vivid benefits for both the sighted and blind person! The example chosen was a trip to India, walking the streets of Old Delhi, visiting the Taj Mahal. Apparently, there are outfits that actually offer this service where both are paying tourists, not as a "care giver."  They made reference to a "dark room" restaurant concept where the sighted can enrich their experience. Never would have thought of this! 

https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/24/podcasts/the-daily/sites-unseen-whats-revealed-by-traveling-with-the-blind.html
